title: 第11章 论坛发帖与官方现身第12章 任务狂潮
lines: 退出游戏的过程，比想象中更加流畅丝滑。
李铭（剑斩红尘）只是集中意识默念了一声“退出”
眼前便是一花，那种短暂的失重感再次袭来，如同穿过一条温暖的隧道。
下一秒，视线重新聚焦，映入眼帘的是熟悉的宿舍景象。
堆满书的书桌，略显凌乱的床铺，以及电脑屏幕上尚未关闭的《修仙OL》官网页面。
他猛地从椅子上站了起来，下意识地低头看向自己的双手。
是那双因为偶尔打球而略带薄茧的，属于现实世界的手。
他又用力掐了一下自己的大腿。
清晰的痛感传来，但与游戏中被削弱的感觉略有不同，是百分之百真实的痛觉。
“果然回来了！”
李铭喃喃自语。
太过真实，以至于分不清虚拟与现实，大概就是他现在这样吧。
他又看了一眼时间，已经晚上七点多。
明明在游戏里干了一整天活，但此刻，他却感觉不到半点疲惫。
反而神清气爽，大脑异常清醒，浑身充满了难以言喻的活力。
“难道玩这游戏还相当于在进行一场深度睡眠？”
李铭心中充满了难以言喻的震撼。
这已经完全超出了他对游戏的认知，妥妥的进入到了黑科技范畴。
毕竟哪个游戏能玩完之后让人精神焕发？
他迫不及待地拿起手机，点开那个名为“《修仙OL》萌新群”
的三人群聊。
果然，里面已经炸锅了。
莽穿地球（王莽）：“我靠，我靠，兄弟们你们怎么样？我回来后，一点累的感觉都没有，精神好得能再去跑十单外卖！”
琉璃仙梦（赵莎）：“我也是！
太神奇了！
明明在游戏里累得半死，回来反而觉得特别放松，脑子特别清楚，这技术……太逆天了啊！”
三人激动地在群里刷着屏。
从游戏登陆器的神秘出现，到百分百真实的五感反馈，从与猛兽搏杀的心悸，到品尝食物的惊奇，再到最后被任务系统激励，疯狂基建的成就感……
每一个细节都让他们回味无穷。
一种强烈的分享欲如同火山喷发，仅仅在三个人的小群里宣泄，显然已经不够了。
但李铭环视了一下空荡荡的宿舍，另外三个哥们儿都已经离校实习，就他一人准备留校考研，连个能当面倾诉的对象都没有。
这种手握惊天秘密却无人可说的感觉，实在憋得慌。
最终，他的目光再次落在了电脑屏幕上那个依旧冷清的玩家论坛。
上面大多还是嘲笑质疑的帖子。
李铭不由深吸一口气，坐回电脑前，敲下一个标题。
【亲身体验，用灵魂起誓！
content_en:
The process of exiting the game is smoother than expected.
Li Ming (Jian Zhan Hongchen) just concentrated his consciousness and silently said "Exit"
There was Ichika in front of me, and that brief feeling of weightlessness came over me again, like walking through a warm tunnel.
The next second, his eyes refocused, and what came into view was the familiar scene of the dormitory.
There is a desk full of books, a slightly messy bed, and the official website page of "Xiu Xian OL" that has not yet been closed on the computer screen.
He suddenly stood up from the chair and subconsciously looked down at his hands.
They are those hands that are slightly calloused from playing ball occasionally and belong to the real world.
He pinched his thigh again.
A clear feeling of pain came, but it was slightly different from the feeling of being weakened in the game. It was 100% real pain.
"Sure enough, I'm back!"
Li Ming murmured to himself.
It's so real that you can't tell the difference between virtuality and reality, which is probably what he is like now.
He looked at the time again, it was already past seven in the evening.
He had obviously been working in the game all day, but at this moment, he didn't feel the slightest bit tired.
On the contrary, I felt refreshed, my brain was extremely clear, and my whole body was filled with indescribable vitality.
"Is playing this game equivalent to going into deep sleep?"
Li Ming's heart was filled with unspeakable shock.
This has completely exceeded his understanding of the game and has fully entered the category of black technology.
After all, which game can make you feel refreshed after playing it?
He couldn't wait to pick up his phone and clicked on the "Cute New Group of "Xiu Xian OL""
group chat of three people.
Sure enough, it was already fried inside.
Mang Chuan Earth (Wang Mang): "Holy shit, holy shit, how are you guys? After I came back, I didn't feel tired at all, and I was in such good spirits that I could go run another ten takeaways!"
Liuli Xianmeng (Zhao Sha): "Me too!
It's amazing!
I was obviously exhausted from playing the game, but when I came back I felt very relaxed and my mind was very clear. This technique... is so incredible! "
The three people excitedly refreshed the screen in the group.
From the mysterious appearance of the game launcher, to the 100% real five-sense feedback, from the heart palpitations of fighting ferocious beasts, to the surprise of tasting food, to finally being inspired by the mission system, the sense of accomplishment of crazy infrastructure...
Every detail makes them unforgettable.
A strong desire to share is like a volcanic eruption. It is obviously no longer enough to vent it in a small group of three people.
But Li Ming looked around the empty dormitory. The other three buddies had already left school for internships. He was the only one preparing to stay in school to take the postgraduate entrance examination. He didn't even have anyone to talk to in person.
This feeling of holding a shocking secret that no one can tell is really frustrating.
Finally, his eyes fell on the still deserted player forum on the computer screen again.
Most of the posts above are still ridiculing and questioning.
Li Ming couldn't help but take a deep breath, sit back in front of the computer, and type out a title.
[Experience it personally and swear it with your soul!
title_en: Chapter 11 Forum Posting and Official Appearance Chapter 12 Mission Frenzy
